description:
Lists the WordPress installations owned by an account.

HTTP: GET /v1/wordpress
Category: WordPress
Required scopes: accounts:read
Returns: {status, data: array of {id, domain_id, subdomain_id, user_id, wp_version, site_title, site_url, admin_url, admin_username, admin_email, install_path, install_subpath, … (+24 more)}, total}
Read-only.

_fields.description: Comma-separated item fields to keep, e.g. "id,domain_name,php_version" — trims large items to what you need.

_limit.description: Keep only the first N items of the returned list (applied by this MCP server, not the panel). Use on large lists.

_match.description: Keep only items whose JSON contains this text (case-insensitive), e.g. a domain name or status.

account_id.description: UUID of the account — obtain it from GET /v1/accounts

name: panelica_wordpress_get_v1_wordpress
